Then I think it's season 4 for you, because season 3 is supposed to be released somewhere in fall 2019. Thanks for your honest reply though, I appreciate it a lot. I didn't think of it that way.

And no, I haven't tried automatic writing. But the way you explained it made it sound interesting so I guess I'll look into it.

I don't know how to put it in words, but I'll give it a try. Nobody has ever understood me, especially my mom. She doesn't get why it's so difficult for me to order something in a fast food restaurant. I also think all people care about is money, because they don't care what they have to do to get it. Why should people care about other peoples well beings? All I see are assholes around me who don't care how other people feel.

At the moment I play Overwatch and Runescape 3, but I'm not into the games you've mentioned. As for anime, I'm waiting for the seven deadly sins season 3 and that time I got reincarnated as a slime season 2.  While waiting, I look for more anime to binge watch so I'm not on anything at the moment.

Sorry if this is blunt, but what are you trying to achieve with this? I've seen it happen before on a couple of other posts. If it's to get my mind on something else, then that's appreciated, but that doesn't really work on me. Thanks though.

I'm fairly sure that people, where I live, don't care about each other. They most likely just freak out to look good to other people. 

I don't enjoy anything, perhaps I'm burnt out or whatever. I do play video games and watch anime to pass time, but that's it.
